query: SELECT event_type,action,actor_login,created_at,updated_at,title,body,comment_id,comments,state,closed_at,file_time,repo_name,number FROM github_events WHERE repo_name='MicrosoftDocs/azure-docs' AND number=48378 AND event_type IN ('IssuesEvent','IssueCommentEvent') ORDER BY created_at,file_time FORMAT JSON
